content.title: Back-to-Back Masters Winners: Rory McIlroy Joins in 2026
content.text: Apr 12, 2026, 9:18 PM min read (AP Photo/Ashley Landis) Rory McIlroy became the latest player to win back-to-back Masters titles in 2026. McIlroy joined Tiger Woods, Nick Faldo and Jack Nicklaus as the only players to achieve the feat. Woods previously held the distinction with back-to-back titles in 2001 and 2002. Amongst the rarest feats in professional golf, only four players have claimed back-to-back Masters titles. Back-to-Back Masters Winners With his win in 2026, Rory McIlroy joined a small group of golfers that claimed back-to-back Masters titles. McIlroy claimed his first green jacket in 2025 to complete the career grand slam. He followed it up with a 2026 win for his sixth major championship. McIlroy also becomes the 19th player with multiple Masters victories. Previously, Tiger Woods last achieved the feat with his wins in 2001 and 2002. It marked the third time in history a player won back-to-back Masters titles. Woods ended a long drought of back-to-back Masters winners. Before Woods, Nick Faldo claimed back-to-back titles in 1989 and 1990. The first to accomplish the feat was Jack Nicklaus, who earned back-to-back green jackets in 1965 and 1966.
